profile.role_note: Free 4-star healer; applies Electro Flare and buffs Resonance Skill DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: One of the strongest 4-star supports and a budget Electro Flare option for Hsin teams; grab a copy whenever she's on a banner you like.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Stellar Symphony or Variation + 5-piece Rejuvenating Glow in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Fallacy of No Return in the main slot. Aim for a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, 150% Energy Regen and 1800+ ATK; Call of the Abyss is the best free option.

ranked_weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
ranked_weapons.note: Shorekeeper's signature, but Game8's top pick for Buling too: she can't trigger its team ATK buff, but the raw Energy Regen and HP stats beat everything. Not her signature.

ranked_weapons.name: Variation
ranked_weapons.note: Cost-effective 4-star; Energy Regen and Concerto Energy on skill, plays out nearly the same.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: Lots of ATK plus some Energy Regen from the weapon skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Call of the Abyss
ranked_weapons.note: Best F2P option; Healing Bonus on Liberation plus Energy Regen and ATK. From the Shadow of the Towers questline.

ranked_weapons.name: Rectifier#25
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen and a conditional ATK buff; usable filler. Free last-resort alternative: the 3-star Rectifier of Voyager.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Her healing is strong enough to fully utilize the set: healing boost plus 15% team ATK on Outro. Fallacy adds Energy Regen and another team ATK buff.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen and an ATK buff for the next Resonator; the ATK buff only affects one party member.

stat_priorities.note: Two 4-cost Healing Bonus pieces is ideal for her healing; ATK% if she's lacking the stat.
Energy Regen on both 3-costs; hit 150% first.
ATK% on both; her heals scale off ATK.

teams.name: Budget: Hsin + Electro Rover + Buling

members.name: Hsin
members.note: Electro Flare hypercarry; benefits from Buling's general DMG and Resonance Skill DMG buffs.

members.name: Electro Rover
members.note: Bulk Electro Flare applicator with the Intro interaction bonus for Hsin.

members.name: Buling
members.note: Applies Electro Flare herself, heals, and buffs Resonance Skill DMG through her Forte-enhanced Liberation.

teams.rotation: Buling opens with Basics into Heavy, skill, Liberation, then Outro to Rover; Rover applies Flare stacks with skill and Liberation, then Hsin enters via Outro to build and detonate.

teams.name: Alternative: Jinhsi + Zhezhi + Buling

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Resonance Skill burst DPS; both Zhezhi and Buling buff her main damage type.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Coordinated attacks to build Incandescence plus Resonance Skill DMG amplification via Outro.

members.name: Buling
members.note: Resonance Skill DMG buff from her Forte-enhanced Liberation, healing, and team-wide DMG amplification.

teams.rotation: Buling runs her Mountain Over Thunder / Twin Thunders combo into Liberation and Outro to Zhezhi; Zhezhi builds Forte, casts her empowered skills and Liberation, then Outro into Jinhsi's full burst combo.

tier_badge.label: Situational
tier_badge.note: Handy Electro Flare support for Hsin teams on a budget.
